action.mutates: installs dnsmasq-base, creates network namespace p8testdhcp and veth pair p8test0 (node) / p8testsrv (namespace, 10.251.0.1/24), and starts dnsmasq in the namespace as transient unit p8test-dhcp (DHCP range 10.251.0.100-150, no DNS)
runs the boot step for /etc/network/interfaces if the node has one (systemctl start networking, else ifup -a), records which in /run/p8test-dhcp-step, and waits up to 20 s for an address on p8test0

outcomes.outcome: the interface's configuration says DHCP at boot (auto, inet dhcp), and ifupdown-extra is installed
at boot the interface gets an address from the LAN's DHCP server
